professionalSummary: Frontend engineer with three years of experience on a design system team, implementing 26 components, writing accessibility and visual regression tests, reviewing contributions, supporting adoption, and documenting releases.
experienceHighlights: Implemented 26 components against product designers' specifications under the library's contribution standard.
Wrote accessibility and visual regression tests for each component, with results attached to pull requests and reviewed by the accessibility specialist.
Reviewed product teams' contributions as one of three reviewers; release approval remained with the design system lead.
Supported product teams' adoption of new components through office hours and migration guides, recording responsibilities in an adoption log.
Documented limitation notes and hand‑over conditions for each library release in the release record.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Three component pull requests with test results and review records; one release record with limitation note; adoption log for one quarter, all linked via repository references.
